profile.name: NI CAN总线接口
profile.description: 这是一类由美国国家仪器提供的CAN总线接口硬件，用于将计算机或测试系统连接到CAN网络，实现报文收发、总线监测与通信控制。常用于汽车电子、工业控制和仪器联调中的设备通信、ECU测试与总线数据采集。
profile.description_en: This is a CAN bus interface device from National Instruments used to connect a computer or test system to a CAN network for message transmission, bus monitoring, and communication control. It is commonly used in automotive electronics, industrial control, and lab test setups for ECU testing, device communication, and CAN data acquisition.
